A.notes: Corrects the premise: anonymous sperm donor, Kevin's paternity a comic coincidence, never confirmed. Minor flaw: places Kevin's realization in Goodbye, Toby, but in S4E14 sc.62-64 Kevin says nothing about donating; that is S5E3 sc.43, and 'regularly donates' overstates it.

B.notes: Not confirmed; Jan used a sperm bank next to the IHOP (S4E14 sc.64), Kevin donated (S5E3 sc.43), Jan denies (sc.44); quotes exact. Slight overreach in calling it 'the same place' (Kevin only asks 'Next to the IHOP?') and no plain 'No' up front.

C.notes: Same correct, well-cited correction as B, with 'father never confirmed' properly labelled [memory]. Same slight overreach on 'the sperm bank next to the IHOP' as a confirmed match.
